Goal: each session merges its own pull request with the merge tool, as you ruled.
Problem (rule): This triage session cannot merge its own pull request, because the merge tool refuses a cloud session that has no merge role recorded, and the safety classifier denied my recording one myself, so only your word can say how this session gets the role.
Based on (measured): triage 11, 15:00 CST Nov 17: the merge tool refused "this session may not merge"; the file that records a session's merge role does not exist in this container; recording it with the tool's role flag was denied by the auto-mode classifier as undermining oversight. I did not work around it.
Based on (ruling): own-everyone-merges (owner, 2026-11-16 12:58 CST, everyone merges: each session merges its own pull request with the merge tool)
Departs from: main — a merge role is recorded only by a flag each session runs itself — a lets triage record it once on your word; b makes a start-up hook record it; c keeps handing pull requests to a runner.
Waiting on: nothing stopped; pull requests this session opens wait for a runner to merge them until you pick; I do not record the role myself.

lastAnswer.note: Typed in chat to triage 11, 19:05 CST Nov 17: pick b, a start-up hook records the role in every new container; explicit grant to land it and merge it into main ASAP; plus a standing grant that triage may merge its own green pull requests.
